_note: Core + detachment stratagems, keyed by id. See NEW_ARMY_BUILD_GUIDE.md §4.4. detachment:null means a Core stratagem, available in every list. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.

command-re-roll.name: Command Re-roll
command-re-roll.summary: Re-roll one dice you just rolled.
command-re-roll.when: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Damage roll, a Hazard roll, a Hit roll, a Save roll, a Wound roll, or a roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.
command-re-roll.effect: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

epic-challenge.name: Epic Challenge
epic-challenge.when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
epic-challenge.effect: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

insane-bravery.name: Insane Bravery
insane-bravery.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a Battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.
insane-bravery.effect: That Battle-shock roll is automatically successful.
insane-bravery.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

fire-overwatch.name: Fire Overwatch
fire-overwatch.summary: Snap shoot at the end of your opponent's Movement phase.
fire-overwatch.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
fire-overwatch.effect: Your unit shoots using a Snap Shooting action. While snap shooting: you can only target one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit (and only if it is an eligible target); each attack only hits on an unmodified Hit roll of 6 (irrespective of the attacking weapon's BS characteristic or any modifiers); and you cannot re-roll Hit rolls.
fire-overwatch.restrictions: After shooting, until the end of the phase your unit is not eligible to start an Action.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.summary: A SMOKE unit and what it screens gain the Benefit of Cover.
smokescreen.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
smokescreen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

heroic-intervention.name: Heroic Intervention
heroic-intervention.summary: Charge at the end of your opponent's Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE/WALKER unit if it is a CHARACTER unit.
heroic-intervention.effect:
Resolve a charge with your unit. Before making the charge roll, select one of the following modes:
• Leap to Defend — when selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the Maximum charge distance.
• Into the Fray (+1CP) — when making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6; and when selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units within 6" of your unit and within the Maximum charge distance.

krump-em.name: Krump ’Em
krump-em.summary: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
krump-em.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ’ARDMOB unit is selected to fight.

medi-squigs.name: Medi-Squigs
medi-squigs.summary: Your unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
medi-squigs.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ’ARDMOB unit.

get-stuck-in.name: Get Stuck In
get-stuck-in.summary: Surge move up to D6+1" after being shot at.
get-stuck-in.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ’ARDMOB unit has shot.
get-stuck-in.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

counter-offensive.name: Counter-offensive
counter-offensive.summary: Fight out of sequence, with Fights First.
counter-offensive.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
counter-offensive.target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
counter-offensive.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight.

_war_horde_note: War Horde detachment stratagems. The id 'war-horde-ard-as-nails' is deliberately prefixed: the stratagem is called ’Ard As Nails, but 'ard-as-nails' is already the id of the Combat Patrol DETACHMENT in data/combat-patrol/index.json. They are unrelated content and must not be merged.

careen.name: Careen!
careen._type_note: The stratagem sub-category (Battle Tactic / Epic Deed / etc.) was not supplied for this one. Fill it in when known.
careen.summary: A destroyed vehicle rolls one last move before it blows.
careen.when: Any phase, just after an ORKS VEHICLE unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
careen.target: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
careen.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.

orks-is-never-beaten.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
orks-is-never-beaten.summary: Slain models still get to swing before they go.
orks-is-never-beaten.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
orks-is-never-beaten.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
orks-is-never-beaten.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

unbridled-carnage.name: Unbridled Carnage
unbridled-carnage.summary: Melee attacks score Critical Hits on an unmodified 5+.
unbridled-carnage.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
unbridled-carnage.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

war-horde-ard-as-nails.name: ’Ard As Nails
war-horde-ard-as-nails.summary: −1 to Wound rolls against your unit.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS, MONSTER and VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
war-horde-ard-as-nails.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

mob-rule.name: Mob Rule
mob-rule.summary: A big mob shouts a nearby unit out of Battle-shock.
mob-rule.target: One MOB unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
mob-rule.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked ORKS INFANTRY unit within 6" of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

ere-we-go.name: ’Ere We Go
ere-we-go.target: One ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army.
ere-we-go.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.
